title: Thermodynamic description of Eu(NO3)3-NaNO3-H2O and Eu(NO3)3-Mg(NO3)2-H2O systems. Solubility experiments and full dissociation Pitzer models

Experimental and model phase diagrams for Eu(NO3)3-NaNO3-H2O and Eu(NO3)3-Mg(NO3)2-H2O systems at 25 °C, based on solubility experiments, XRD characterization, Schreinemakers' method, controlled relative humidity experiments and Pitzer equations.
